# AI Usage Plus 1.0.0
The first release of AI Usage Plus, an independently maintained open-source fork of [AI Usage](https://github.com/burakgon/ai-usage-menubar) by Burak Gon.
- Track the Antigravity Argon quota pool and send the current CLI user agent. - Add a DeepSeek provider that shows your API balance as a bar from your starting balance down to zero, with the official DeepSeek logo. - Fix provider cards overlapping the footer while scrolling the popover. - Fix the Grok icon looking thin and cut off. - Add an Edit menu so text fields accept paste. - Ship under a new bundle identifier (`com.rafalozan0.aiusageplus`) with its own update feed, so it can be installed next to the original app.
Install with Homebrew: `brew install --cask rafalozan0/tap/ai-usage-plus`.
